description.text: Students mainly study in the basic theories and knowledge in math, foundamental physics, physical electronics, optoelectronics, microelectronics. And they will take the basic training at information electronic experiment technology, computer technology, the ability to design, research and develop electronic materials, component and system. This program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in electronical materials, component, integrate circuit, developing and researching new technology, etc. Given the strong focus on Micro-Electronics, graduates will be particularly well equipped for employment in the micro-electronics industry. Main Courses: Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, Computer Architecture Foundation and Logical Design, Introduction to Electronical Science and Technology, Signal and System, Fundamentals of Electronic Circuits, Micro Computer System and Interface, Theory of Electromagnetic Fields, Semiconductor Physics, Photoelectron Physical Basis, Electronic Device, VLSI Design, Display Technology, Photoelectronic Technique, Fiber Optic Communications, Digital Signal Processing, etc.

duration.text: The Electrical Engineering and Automatio at Hubei Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above

requirements.text: Applicants with an educational background equal to high school graduation in China, and Band 3 certificate in HSK (Examination on Chinese language level), or have studied Chinese for more than one year.
